title: Design, sizes, and capacity of materials, structures, temporary construction, and equipment.
officialText:
Design, sizes, and
capacities of materials, structures, temporary construction, and equipment shall be in accordance with the requirements of Sections
3301.6.1 through 3301.6.3.
